title: Chapter 772
text:
"I didn't say that, but you knew that Black Star was our enemy, yet you didn't tell us the news. Isn't that a violation of the alliance? If we had known that Black Star was on our side, we would've definitely asked the Tyrant to cancel this battle, and today's joke wouldn't have happened. "

"You're exaggerating." Zoel was not angry and said with a smile, "Hiding the news was Black Star's request, and I personally agreed to it. I sent the garrison troops to the scene to prevent the situation from escalating … Furthermore, isn't the result today good? The entire Star Field knows that you and the Black Star Corps have turned from enemies to friends, which is beneficial to both parties' influence. Overall, not only did you not lose anything, you actually gained something. After all, a grand event like today is rare."

"… Then, it seems like we misunderstood you." The Klent official clenched his teeth and smiled.

"That's right. Sigh, you can't say that. I'm indeed responsible for this. How about this? I'll apologize to the dynasty's upper echelons and apply for resource compensation for you. What do you think?" Zoel said with a smile.

"You're exaggerating. We misunderstood you first. You're not responsible."

"Alright, but to express my apologies, please accept the resources as compensation."

"Okay."

After hanging up, Zoel's smile disappeared, and he nodded with satisfaction.

Klent was very tactful. Not bad.

…

Not long after, the Bloodshed Land at the scene received a message from Klent.

Joad swallowed and stammered, "Your Excellency Tyrant, there's a result from Klent."

"Speak."

"They said that it was Zoel's idea to allow Black Star to join the alliance. Klent wants us to stop the battle and immediately … immediately retreat."

Klent knew that they had been tricked by the Red Empire, but what could they do? They still wanted to develop in the Flickering World, so there was no way they could cancel the alliance. Thus, they could only swallow their pride.

Black Star's bargaining chip was too tempting. Klent knew that the Red Empire would not reject the Evolution Cube, so they could only admit that they were unlucky. Thankfully, the battle was mainly the Tyrant's idea, and Klent did not lose much. Thus, they compromised very quickly.

Hearing this, Heber closed his eyes.

After a while, he opened his eyes again. His cheeks were puffed up as he squeezed out a word.

"Retreat."

As the order sounded in the Bloodshed Land's command channel, the many Bloodshed Land officers instantly became listless and listless.

Joad's face twitched. However, there was nothing he could do.

The Red Red, Klent, and Bloodshed Land's' fleet's fleet, leaving, and the Black Star Corps fleet.

"The Bloodshed Land's retreated!"

In the countless battleships't were the Black Star Corps's the atmosphere.

The players''s't't't

When Ames saw this, her eyes curved into crescents, and she smiled.

Although Han Xiao's concealment made her a little unhappy, seeing Heber suffer in the hands of her and Han Xiao made her feel a lot better.

"In the pugilistic world, you have no choice." Han Xiao's expression under the helmet was rather playful. "Tyrant? Hehe. '

The battle between the two of them had been interrupted for some reason, and there was no clear victor. However, in the previous battle, he had not been at a disadvantage and had fought to a draw with the Tyrant. No one would think that he had joined the Red Empire because he was afraid of the Tyrant.

The Tyrant was the one who had agreed to the battle, but in the end, he had left with his tail between his legs. This was equivalent to him becoming a stepping stone, stepping on the Tyrant's name and establishing his position in the Shattered Star Ring. He would no longer be looked down upon because of the name of a new Beyond Grade A Super.

At this time, a notification of Legendary Points appeared on his interface.

You have received 3 Legendary Points.

Star Field Legendary Points (Shattered Star Ring): Battle of the Tyrant — Your battle with Heber the Tyrant is known to everyone in the Shattered Star Ring. This battle will become a legend in the Star Field, and your name will be passed down.

Star Field Legendary Points (Shattered Star Ring): Red Empire's Ally — Universal Civilizations are the largest organizations in the galaxy. You have formed an alliance with one of them, the Red Empire, and all the organizations in the Star Field will be wary of you.

Star Field Legendary Points (Shattered Star Ring): Star Field Iconic Figure — Your name will be known throughout the entire Star Field. Your name will be one of the symbols of this Star Field. From today onward, when the Shattered Star Ring is mentioned, your name will be the first to be remembered.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Star Field Legendary Points gave far more EXP than Star Cluster Legendary Points and were extremely difficult to obtain. Now that he had received three points, it meant that he had been very successful in establishing his dominance.

When this news spread throughout the Shattered Star Ring, his reputation in the Shattered Star Ring would definitely soar.

At this time, Ralph requested for communication.

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat. He knew Purple Crystal's reaction to this and had already thought of what to say.

"Black Star …"

The communication was connected, and Ralph's face appeared on the tactical screen of the mechanical suit's helmet.

"I know what you mean." Han Xiao interrupted him and said, "Joining the Red Empire was my idea. You all know that the secret war is disadvantageous to us. If we want to destroy Klent's plan, we can only start from the top. I used joining the Red Empire as a bargaining chip in exchange for their stance on the secret war. This is the way to win the secret war that I told you before."

Hearing this, Ralph opened his mouth with a complicated expression.

He originally thought that Black Star would abandon Purple Crystal and join the Red Empire. Now that he heard Han Xiao say this, he felt much better.

Luckily, Black Star still remembered Purple Crystal's support and made a request to the dynasty to repay Purple Crystal. At the very least, he did not abandon them after receiving their support for so long.

"The Red Empire and you, sigh …"

"I know that you all wish to maintain the independence of your civilization, but I'm different. I'm also an ally of Purple Crystal, which is equivalent to building a bridge between you and the Red Empire. Becoming the middleman between you all is beneficial to all three of us."

Ralph could not help but nod. That was indeed the case.

He understood what Han Xiao meant. Joining the Red Empire while maintaining the alliance with Purple Crystal was a choice that only children would make. Adults wanted both.

Of course, Purple Crystal was unwilling. They had supported the Black Star Corps for almost ten years because they wanted to be the biggest partner behind a Beyond Grade A, but they were being taken advantage of by a Universal Civilization that they could not afford to offend.

However, thinking about it carefully, he felt helpless. After today's battle, the Black Star Corps would be fully fledged. If Purple Crystal terminated the alliance, the Black Star Corps would not be afraid because they had better options. In the end, Purple Crystal would be the one to suffer.

The best choice now was to maintain the relationship and become an ally second only to the Red Empire, sharing the benefits brought by the Black Star Corps.

After investing so many resources, Purple Crystal was not willing to return empty-handed.

"I understand. I'll report this to the upper echelons …" Ralph adjusted his emotions and secretly admired Black Star's ability.

"Wait for my good news." Han Xiao smiled and said politely.

If he was just an ordinary Beyond Grade A, he might not have had the face to make the Red Empire change their stance regarding the secret war. However, with the weight of the Evolution Cube, it was different.

After reaching a consensus with Ralph, Han Xiao hung up the communication and secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

The situation was great, and Han Xiaoxin was relaxed. After entering the Beyond Grade A realm, he had truly reached the peak of Galaxy. Most of the restrictions that Calamity Grades faced had disappeared, and his Face Fruit ability had skyrocketed.

This time, a teleportation door opened beside Han Xiao, and Austin, who had been secretly observing, walked out.

"Hehe, congratulations, Black Star," Austin greeted with a smile.

Han Xiao replied with a laugh.

Seeing this, Austin did not say much and smiled. "This is not a good place to talk. Let's talk again at the next Tyrant Party."

Then, he teleported back to the Palace of Hidden Spells and activated the magic formation. The palace flew into the teleportation door and disappeared.

"Tyrant Party …"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. When the Tyrant held the next party, he did not know if they would take the initiative to invite him.

"Since the matter is settled, I'll take my leave first." Ames waved her hands and flew back to Floating Dragon. Floating Dragon slowly left.

Han Xiao watched as Ames left. This time, he returned to the flagship of the Black Star Corps. He walked into the command room and saw that the officers of the army were all gathered there. The moment he walked in, everyone's eyes turned toward him with respect.

"Sylvia, Herlous, inform the fleet to return." Han Xiao nodded.

"Understood!" Sylvia's face was filled with excitement.

"Also, in the name of the Black Star Corps, issue a recruitment order to the entire Star Field. It's time for those who are watching to make a choice." Han Xiao smiled.

Because of the battle with the Tyrant, the Black Star Corps had been keeping a low profile during this period. Now that everything was settled, it was time for the Black Star Corps to expand and officially become a Beyond Grade A organization!

Many officers were excited. Wasn't this the day they had been waiting for?

Han Xiao turned to look at Fu Ding. He had not collected the mission reward and had drawn the Tyrant's ability just to get some luck.

Patting Fu Ding's shoulder, Han Xiao gave a few words of encouragement and sent all the officers away with the excuse of resting.

Han Xiao returned to his room alone and opened the interface to collect the reward.

You have received a reward: Draw one of Heber's abilities (Ability/Talent).

Tip: Heber is a Pugilist. Some of the abilities have been adjusted according to your class.

Randomizing … Randomizing complete!

Please select one from the following five options as the reward:

1. [Phantom Combo] – Ability: + 75% Melee Attack Speed. Duration: 7s. Cost: 80 Energy. Cooldown: 18s.

2. [Star Tossing Power] – Ability: Using Energy Secret Technique to strengthen cells. + 600 STR. Duration: 20s. Cooldown: 120s.

3. [Weakness Insight] – Ability: + 30% Melee Critical Chance. Duration: 15s. Cooldown: 180s.

4. [Melee Killer] – Talent: + 40% Melee Attack and Attack Speed. + 2 All Melee Skill Levels.

5. [Heber Stellar Furnace Training Technique] – Ability: The Tyrant's special energy training technique. Current Effect: + 500 Energy. Number of Training: 0/650. Requires training on a Fixed Star. The effect of each training depends on the time spent on the Fixed Star. The maximum effect of a single training session is 25 Energy. Lower limit is 0. Each training session costs 600 EXP.

Glancing at the first four options, Han Xiao was a little disappointed. A Beyond Grade A Pugilist had countless abilities, and the chances of drawing something good were very low. All four options were of limited use to him.

However, the last ability made Han Xiao's expression change, and he was overjoyed.

"This is the Tyrant's energy training technique?"

This is good stuff.

A Pugilist's energy came partly from their talents and partly from their energy training techniques.

When others reached Beyond Grade A, they would start to collect all kinds of energy training techniques if they wanted to continue becoming stronger. The longer one was a Beyond Grade A, the more energy they would have.

Currently, he had encountered a bottleneck in the conversion of HP and MP. Apart from the 28% recovery rate, another limitation was his Energy Value. Compared to his 2,000,000 HP, his Energy Value was only 50,000, which was too low. Instead, it became a restriction to his tankiness.

Although [Radiation Absorption] could increase his energy, it required a very long time to accumulate. Even if he learned from the other Beyond Grade As and collected the energy training techniques of the various races, it would still be a long-term project. Heber's energy training technique was a shortcut for him to increase his strength. A high-level secret technique created by a Beyond Grade A Beyond Grade A had an extremely obvious effect in increasing energy.

As for the huge amount of experience required for the players … Han Xiao happened to have an experience penalty of more than ten months, so he did not need to level up.

You have received [Heber Stellar Furnace Training Technique]!

Han Xiao looked at it with satisfaction, closed the interface, and began to think.

"The biggest problem is solved for now. Next is the expansion of the Black Star Corps. The layout of the Flickering World should be put on the agenda … Oh, right, when the army stabilizes, I still have to make a trip to the Central Galaxy …"

…

At the same time, somewhere in the Central Galaxy …

On the screen was a news channel broadcasting the battle in the Shattered Star Ring. The audience had already started to disperse.

Beep.

The image was turned off, and EsGod's face was reflected on the dark screen.

"Help me contact Black Star."
